mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_payment_report ( report_date, user_id, start_recharge_times, start_recharge_amt, start_recharge_failed_times, recharge_success_times, recharge__success_amt, manual_recharge_times, manual_recharge_amt, channel_fee, marketer_fee ) SELECT p.proc_date, p.user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_recharge_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS start_recharge_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_recharge_failed_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recharge_success_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS recharge_success_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manual_recharge_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS manual_recharge_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN p.channel_fee ELSE 0 END) AS channel_fee, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN p.marketer_fee ELSE 0 END) AS marketer_fee FROM p_payment_proc p LEFT JOIN s_channel c ON c.id = p.channel_id WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} -- 增量订单 ID 区间 GROUP BY p.proc_date, p.user_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_recharge_times = start_recharge_times + VALUES(start_recharge_times), start_recharge_amt = start_recharge_amt + VALUES(start_recharge_amt), start_recharge_failed_times = start_recharge_failed_times + VALUES(start_recharge_failed_times), recharge_success_times = recharge_success_times + VALUES(recharge_success_times), recharge__success_amt = recharge__success_amt + VALUES(recharge__success_amt), manual_recharge_times = manual_recharge_times + VALUES(manual_recharge_times), manual_recharge_amt = manual_recharge_amt + VALUES(manual_recharge_amt), channel_fee = channel_fee + VALUES(channel_fee)
